answer: By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jetty of the next round. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
